description:
Outcome: The coordinator sees all 40 plots with current holders and vacancies, from brief.md / First version must 5, explicitly deferred until after first version by owner conversation.
Scope: Configurable plot grid positions, coordinator-only map, holder/vacancy labels and accessible list alternative. Excludes: gardener/public map, contact exposure, payments and tool lending.
Acceptance: Show all 40 stable plots exactly once; holders/vacancies reflect registry and allocations; layout positions persist; coordinator-only authorization enforced; no color-only meaning.
Behaviour: Phone and keyboard usability; clear empty/loading/failure/retry states; reject duplicate or invalid layout positions safely.
Verification: Layout persistence, plot count, assignment synchronization, authorization/privacy and accessibility tests. Prerequisites: T-002, T-006 and T-007 for data, and T-013 for the owner's after-first-version sequencing constraint. Assumptions: coordinator specifies layout; no inferred real-world geography. This ticket is not part of first-version acceptance.
title: Coordinator plot map (after first version)
